column2:
Lack of system for employees to anonymously 
report issues; lack of written policies on collusion 
or fair advertising

Working hours in excess of 60 hours per week; 
workers not given at least one day off in seven

Concerns about personal protective equipment 
use or availability, access to unobstructed exits, 
and worker exposure to hazards

Issues with on-site storage of chemical and 
hazardous waste (segregation and proper containers)

Lack of documentation and management systems 
for corporate responsibility and labor issues; 
inadequate communication on policies, systems, 
and performance

column1:
1  In 2013, the Electronic Industry Citizenship Coalition (EICC) downgraded the rating on working hours violations cases that fall between 60 hours per week and a stricter local law. The violation was previously classified as a priority finding and is  
now a major finding. We disagree with this change and will not alter how we address these findings with our suppliers.
